title: Gloom's Stink Has a Danger Switch
premise: Gloom's foul fragrance worsens when it faces danger, but vanishes when it feels calm and secure.
audiencePromise: Watch Gloom's fragrance rise under danger, then discover why safety shuts it off.
openLoop: What makes Gloom's foul fragrance rise, then vanish?
payoff: Gloom does not simply stink. Its fragrance changes with whether the world feels dangerous or safe.
engagementQuestion: Smart danger switch, or terrible design?

voice.instructions: Speak with tense curiosity. Start sharp, build urgency as danger affects the fragrance, then relax noticeably when safety shuts it off. Keep every line punchy and clear.

scenes.headline: A STINK WITH AN OFF-SWITCH
scenes.narration: Gloom's stink has a danger switch—and an off-switch.
scenes.caption: A STINK WITH AN OFF-SWITCH

scenes.headline: THE FLOWER IS THE SOURCE
scenes.narration: The source is its flower's pistil, releasing a foul fragrance.
scenes.caption: FOUL FRAGRANCE FROM THE PISTIL

scenes.headline: DANGER MAKES THE STENCH WORSE
scenes.narration: When Gloom faces danger, the foul fragrance from its pistil worsens.
scenes.caption: FACING DANGER MAKES IT WORSE

scenes.headline: SAFETY CHANGES EVERYTHING
scenes.narration: Then calm and security remove Gloom's usual stinky aroma.
scenes.caption: CALM AND SECURE: USUAL AROMA STOPS

scenes.headline: ITS SIGNATURE SMELL IS CONDITIONAL
scenes.narration: In danger its stench worsens. Calm and secure, Gloom releases no usual aroma.
scenes.caption: A RESPONSE, NOT A CONSTANT

scenes.headline: SMART SWITCH OR BAD DESIGN?
scenes.narration: Smart danger switch, or terrible design?
scenes.caption: SMART SWITCH OR BAD DESIGN?
